description: This file provides integration with Google Cloud Key Management Service (KMS), including environment validation and client setup functions for use within the litellm project.

classes.name: KeyManagementSystem
classes.description: An enumeration for different key management systems, specifically referenced from litellm.proxy._types.

methods.name: validate_environment()
methods.description: Checks for the presence of necessary environment variables for Google KMS operation.

methods.name: load_google_kms(use_google_kms: Optional[bool])
methods.description: Initializes the Google KMS client if requested, assigning it to litellm and setting relevant configuration.
